source.title: Generalised Prisms and Euclidean Ramsey Theory
source.version_qualification: Exact arXivv1; no journal equivalence or acceptance certified.

reading.method: Native PDF text plus Poppler160dpi PNG pages viewed at original detail; no OCR.
reading.scope: Every primary statement, proof, figure, note and reference on all10pages. Figures are not used as measurements or as unproved coverage certificates.

definitions.scope: Fixed point and spherical orbit; subgroup, image, product and extension solubility; geometric enclosure/subset closure. Compilation expansion of elementary prerequisites.

isometric_extension.scope: Affine isometric extension into added orthogonal dimensions. Compilation prerequisite for the enclosure clause.

lemma_2.scope: Printed statement quoted with its lambda'' misprint marked; proof pointer; equality case and chosen soluble transitive group noted.

lemma_3.scope: Printed statement quoted; proof pointer; x=y case and the unneeded common-centre assertion noted with the exact cross distance.

theorem_1.scope: Printed statement quoted; proof pointer through Lemmas 2 and 3; coincident orbits handled by a two-level product; Ramsey clause relative to Kriz.

corollary_4.scope: Printed statement quoted; proof pointer; corpus enclosure step for a merely subsoluble base via isometric_extension.

corollary_5.scope: Printed statement quoted; proof pointer with lcm enlargement; arbitrary radii and relative angle.

examples.scope: Isosceles trapezia, triangle and its side-midpoint triangle, rationally rotated rectangles via a finite dihedral orbit.

zero_height_obstruction.scope: Triangle plus center nonspherical in every dimension; not subtransitive; not Ramsey relative to exact Paper I Theorem13.

conjecture_6.scope: Definitions and printed conjecture; geometric implication for a fixed template sketched; conjecture itself not proved.

template_symmetry_qualification.scope: Template1122 central complement reflection is not any fixed coordinate permutation, even for algebraically independent alphabet values.

soluble_prime_degree.scope: Faithful soluble transitive subgroup of S_p has normal regular C_p and order at most p(p-1). Replaces source classification-table appeal.

theorem_7.scope: Printed statement quoted; proof pointer; prime-degree bound replaces the classification table; diagram alpha6 misprint noted.

block_template_consequences.scope: Geometric subsolubility/Ramsey via Theorem7+Kriz; particular uniform-block conclusions via exact earlier LRW family and alphabet relabeling; direct block-restriction inheritance. General converse not asserted.

two_color_observation.scope: Spherical2-Ramsey base, height strictly above circumradius; explicit forcing dimension max(N2,2e+2), sphere recurrence, opposite colors, unbounded growth and final embedding.

conjecture_8.scope: Printed conjecture quoted; the paper's Section 4 remarks; later Moore/Mirabi results linked as context.

kriz_theorem_4_3.citation: Kriz, Permutation groups in Euclidean Ramsey Theory, ProcAMS112(1991)899–907, Theorem4.3 printed906, orbit/Ramsey definitions printed901.
kriz_theorem_4_3.exact_interface: Finite configuration with a soluble transitive isometry group is Ramsey; subset closure proved locally.

paper_i_theorem_13.citation: Erdos et al., Euclidean Ramsey Theorems I(1973), Theorem13 printed349, PDF9.
paper_i_theorem_13.exact_interface: Every finite Ramsey set is spherical.

lrw_theorem_3_1_uniform_family.citation: Leader,Russell,Walters author manuscript dated22November2010, Theorem3.1 p12 and uniformity pp14–15; later JCTA119(2012)382–396 DOI10.1016/j.jcta.2011.09.005.
lrw_theorem_3_1_uniform_family.exact_interface: For every positive r,s,k, a uniform block set of template1^r2^s3 is forced in some[3]^N, with a common positive block size d.
lrw_theorem_3_1_uniform_family.version_qualification: 2010author version inspected; published bibliographic record identified but no full-text equivalence claimed.
lrw_theorem_3_1_uniform_family.reading_limit: Selected definitions, conjecture-equivalence statements, Theorem3.1, explicit common-size construction and uniformity remark; not a complete proof audit of the external paper.

lrw_full_equivalence_background.citation: Same author manuscript Section2, ConjecturesB–F, Propositions2.1/2.2/2.4.
lrw_full_equivalence_background.scope: External equivalence of the full uniform block conjecture and finite-power Ramsey conjecture; not used in the numbered prism/group proof chain or specific block deductions.

source_findings.issue: Nonempty finite configurations and congruent containment in a higher space are implicit; p.1 parenthetical after not spherical describes spherical.
source_findings.treatment: Nonempty configurations and congruent enclosure are defined explicitly; spherical means contained in a sphere. Optional empty cases are not needed by transitive-orbit statements.

source_findings.issue: a is required nonzero although equal heights are allowed; a full symmetry group is incorrectly inferred soluble from subsolubility.
source_findings.treatment: Handle equality directly and choose an actual soluble transitive witness subgroup.

source_findings.issue: n and zero-height endpoints are compressed, interpolation initially says positive coefficients but uses zero endpoints.
source_findings.treatment: Take n>=1; allow endpoint coefficients; x=y implies coincident orbits and P0=X; Theorem1 handles X=Y by a direct two-level product.

source_findings.issue: The two orbits need not have the same center.
source_findings.treatment: Use exact cross squared distances; no center coincidence is needed. A trivial group on two singleton orbits witnesses failure of the general center claim.

source_findings.issue: The short proof covers a group acting directly on the base but does not justify a merely subsoluble base.
source_findings.treatment: Full Gram-matrix extension into extra coordinates transports the arbitrary apex projection into the transitive enclosure.

source_findings.issue: The finite common orbit for rationally rotated rectangles is implicit; polygon sizes and relative angle need precise quantification.
source_findings.treatment: Construct the finite dihedral orbit for rectangles and lcm polygon enlargement for arbitrary relative angle.

source_findings.issue: Alphabet displayed as alpha1,...,alpha_n rather than alpha_m; degree differs from LRW2010 convention.
source_findings.treatment: Use m alphabet values; ILW degree d is common block size, LRW total degree is l*d.

source_findings.issue: Algebraic independence does not ensure that all geometric symmetries are coordinate permutations.
source_findings.treatment: Complete1122 complement-reflection counterexample; keep Theorem7 on explicitly specified coordinate actions. General geometric converse is not inferred.
source_findings.kind: complete counterexample to printed broad claim

source_findings.issue: Negative half appeals to an external transitive-group classification.
source_findings.treatment: Elementary soluble prime-degree bound gives42<105, with full proof; no table required.
source_findings.kind: complete alternative deduction of the same step

source_findings.issue: Solubility of affine-semilinear group cited as standard; diagram repeats alpha5; c is implicitly distinct from1.
source_findings.treatment: Explicit F8 construction and normal series; last position alpha6; c in F8 minus{0,1}; all6 cases written.

source_findings.issue: The particular block consequences should not rely on the false full-symmetry identification or on an unspecified converse.
source_findings.treatment: Use the exact LRW2010author Theorem3.1 with uniformity, relabel1<->3, plus direct final-block restriction. General finite-power machinery stays external.

source_findings.issue: R^(2d+1) need not already force the base; the paragraph lacks a dimension for embedding the pyramid on arbitrary larger spheres, explicit radius growth, and alternation of colors.
source_findings.treatment: N=max(N2,2e+2), e+2 dimensional sphere space, explicit circumcenter and F(r), positive squared increment>=t^2-R^2, opposite forced colors and extra perpendicular embedding.
source_findings.kind: complete same-method reconstruction with proved repairs

source_findings.issue: Conjecture8 and example questions are historical; square rectangles are already covered at all angles.
source_findings.treatment: Link exact later Moore/Mirabi results; preserve conditional classification implications and historical nonsquare/offset examples without current-open claims.

source_findings.issue: Frankl–Rodl volume/pages (and pluralized title) and ILW Block sizes volume are inaccurate.
source_findings.treatment: Original FR title A partition property of simplices in Euclidean space, JAMS3(1990)1–7; publisher confirms Block sizes Sigma14(2026)e67.
